lines.en: Good morning, sir. Tickets are checked at the door, please.
lines.pt: Bom dia, senhor. Os ingressos são conferidos na porta, por favor.

lines.en: Here you are. Is photography allowed here?
lines.pt: Aqui está. Fotografar é permitido aqui?

lines.en: Yes, photos are allowed, but flash is not allowed in the old rooms.
lines.pt: Sim, fotos são permitidas, mas flash não é permitido nas salas antigas.

lines.en: I see. Are drinks allowed inside the exhibition?
lines.pt: Entendi. Bebidas são permitidas na exposição?

lines.en: No, food and drinks are forbidden. They are only allowed in the garden.
lines.pt: Não, comida e bebida são proibidas. Só são permitidas no jardim.

lines.en: OK. Are dogs allowed? My friend has a small one.
lines.pt: Certo. Cães são permitidos? Meu amigo tem um pequeno.

lines.en: Only guide dogs are allowed. Other pets are not accepted.
lines.pt: Só cães-guia são permitidos. Outros animais não são aceitos.

lines.en: That is fine. Is the museum open every day?
lines.pt: Tudo bem. O museu abre todos os dias?

lines.en: It is closed on Mondays. The rooms are cleaned on that day.
lines.pt: Fecha às segundas. As salas são limpas nesse dia.

lines.en: Good to know. Are big bags kept somewhere safe?
lines.pt: Bom saber. Bolsas grandes são guardadas em algum lugar seguro?

lines.en: Yes, they are kept in the lockers by the stairs. Enjoy your visit!
lines.pt: Sim, são guardadas nos armários perto da escada. Boa visita!

facts.label: Passivo no presente
facts.sub: Use is/are + particípio: Photos are allowed. Na pergunta, inverta: Is photography allowed?

facts.label: é/são + particípio
facts.sub: Use is ou are + particípio para falar de regras sem quem as faz: Photos are allowed. Food is forbidden. Use is no singular e are no plural.

facts.label: … é permitido?
facts.sub: Para perguntar sobre regras: Is photography allowed? Are dogs allowed? Inverta: is/are + sujeito + allowed. Resposta: Yes, it is. / No, they are not.

items.s: Is photography allowed? asks about a rule.
We form the present passive with am, is or are + past participle.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Is photography allowed? asks about a rule. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We form the present passive with am, is or are + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Photography is allow.” → Falso (We need the participle: allowed.)

pages.title: A museum in Brighton · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny morning in Brighton. Dan walks up to a small museum. Joy stands at the door with a list. Many visitors wait in line. Dan has a camera and a bag. He wants to know the rules.

“Good morning, sir. Tickets are checked at the door, please.” says Joy. “Here you are. Is photography allowed here?” says Dan. “Yes, photos are allowed, but flash is not allowed in the old rooms.” says Joy.
